literal: Unable to close, sorrow suffer, sea uncontainable love-sickness caused my eyes.
translation: My eyes, which caused this love-sickness vaster than the ocean, now suffer in sorrow, unable to close in sleep.
modern: கடலை விடப் பெரியதான இந்தக் காதல் நோயை எனக்கு உண்டாக்கிய என் கண்கள், இப்போது தூங்க முடியாமல் துன்பப்படுகின்றன.
explanation: The speaker blames her own eyes for her immense suffering. It was her eyes that first looked at her lover, bringing upon her a love-sickness that is vaster than the ocean. Now, in a fitting turn of events, those very eyes are unable to close in sleep and are suffering in sorrow. The couplet beautifully captures the irony of the eyes being both the cause of the passion and the victims of its resulting sleeplessness.
